description: Source code for a GNSS driver for Quectel LCX6G modules in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GNSS interface functions, power management, and communication with the modem via UART and chat scripts.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_configure_pps
methods.description: Configures the PPS mode on the GNSS module via chat script.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_pm_changed
methods.description: Updates the power management timeout.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_await_pm_ready
methods.description: Waits until the power management is ready.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_resume
methods.description: Resumes GNSS operation, reinitializing UART and chat scripts.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_suspend
methods.description: Suspends GNSS operation, running suspend scripts.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_turn_on
methods.description: Logs powering on event.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_turn_off
methods.description: Logs powering off event and closes UART pipe.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions (suspend, resume, turn on/off).

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_set_fix_rate
methods.description: Sets the GNSS fix rate via chat script.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_get_fix_rate
methods.description: Retrieves the current fix rate from the GNSS module.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_set_navigation_mode
methods.description: Sets the navigation mode (e.g., stationary, drone).

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_get_navigation_mode
methods.description: Gets the current navigation mode.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_set_enabled_systems
methods.description: Enables or disables GNSS systems (GPS, GLONASS, etc.).

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_get_enabled_systems
methods.description: Retrieves enabled GNSS systems.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_get_supported_systems
methods.description: Returns all supported GNSS systems.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_init_nmea0183_match
methods.description: Initializes NMEA0183 message matching.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_init_pipe
methods.description: Initializes UART backend pipe.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_init_chat
methods.description: Initializes chat interface.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_init_dynamic_script
methods.description: Initializes dynamic chat script.

methods.name: quectel_lcx6g_init
methods.description: Main driver initialization function.
